scope: Static-shape tt.scan workloads, priced from the first operand geometry and element width without direction, combine or result-count restrictions.

simd.description: SIMD tt.scan pricing. Multi-dim scans are piecewise linear in the column-parallel step count S = extent * ceil(columns/BpE): dependency_factor is the base slope, dependency_factor_multi_tail the extra slope above the hinge, startup_system_cycles charged once. 1D scans follow the CumsumSimtSklansky.cpp template, dispatching on element count: dependency_factor_1d_small (extent <= 64) and the Sklansky element-round factors dependency_factor_1d_work / dependency_factor_1d_tiled_work above it, with startup_system_cycles_1d / startup_system_cycles_1d_small charged once. A non-leading-axis multi-dim scan also pays a transpose: transpose_dim01_bytes_per_system_cycle for rank >= 3, transpose_ar2ra_bytes_per_system_cycle plus transpose_ar2ra_fixed_system_cycles for rank 2. dependency_factor_1d is only the SIMT legacy / fallback factor.

simt.description: SIMT tt.scan pricing. Multi-dim scans use the warp-shape-aware additive table simt_2d_warp_segments (cost = a + b*N + c*(N*k)/T + d*max(0, N/T - r0), with a_subwarp / b_subwarp for extent < 32); 1D scans use the three-segment table simt_1d_warp_segments. dependency_factor and dependency_factor_1d remain the fallback when a table is absent and for the LoopCarriedRecurrence scan path.
